sections.heading: Narendra Modi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Narendra Modi was born on 17 September 1950 in Vadnagar, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Narendrabhai Damodardas Modi at birth and is publicly known as Narendra Modi.
Public records name his father, Damodardas Mulchand Modi and his mother, Heeraben Modi.
His listed education includes Gujarat University and University of Delhi.
He is recorded as speaking English, Gujarati, Sanskrit and Punjabi.

sections.heading: Narendra Modi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Narendra Modi works primarily as a politician, writer, social worker and bibliographer.
Among the credits most often linked to Narendra are Exam Warriors and Mann Ki Baat.
He has held the following offices: Prime Minister of India (2014–present) and Member of the Lok Sabha (2024–present). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in 2017 SCO Summit, 2018 Qingdao SCO summit, 8th BRICS summit, 9th BRICS summit and 7th BRICS summit.
